purpose: Teach: 内戦/銃撃/ラテン語/追い出さ/置き去り/煽っ/潰さ/吸い込ま

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、内戦の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the history of civil war, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Gentle confirmation rather than question. Steady eye contact. The tone of a teacher who's genuinely interested in the student's work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、銃撃事件の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the sociology of gun violence.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Brief, specific. A slight pause before answering, like he's gathered his thoughts. Steady but not confident-sounding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ラテン語の語源を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you explored Latin etymology, if I remember correctly?
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Slower pace — thinking as she speaks. Not challenging, just remembering aloud with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政争で都を追い出された貴族を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the nobles who were exiled from the capital during political upheaval.
lines.style: Direct, specific answer. Slightly more confident in this detail. Still measured, but with the sense of someone who knows his material.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災地に置き去りにされた人々を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You also wrote about the people left behind in disaster zones, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged, present. Warm affirmation in her voice. The rhythm of someone drawing out what matters. Slight emphasis on 'you,' making it personal.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、群衆を煽った独裁者を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the demagogue who incited the crowd.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact precision. Not defensive, just clarifying. Brief, steady. The tone of someone correcting gently but firmly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 民主主義が潰された国家を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And the collapse of democracy in a nation — that was part of your work too?
lines.style: Reflective, slower cadence. The tone of drawing threads together, connecting ideas. Not interrogating, but thoughtfully reviewing. Slight trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ブラックホールに吸い込まれた星の運命を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the fate of stars as they were pulled into black holes.
lines.style: Quiet, steady finish. No apology in his voice, just matter-of-fact. The faintest sense of him holding firm to his own train of thought, unbothered by the mismatch.
